TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，你来了！欢迎欢迎！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Navigator, you made it! Welcome, welcome!

TextContext.SourceString: 再次介绍一下，我叫米雪儿，我的爱好是猫咪和游戏……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let me introduce myself again. I'm Michele, and I love cats and gaming...

TextContext.SourceString: 说到游戏，如果你也经常光顾“NO.1的游戏论坛”，你应该听过知名版主“超级喵喵卫士”吧？她经常在论坛更新游戏攻略，分享游戏资讯……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Speaking of games, if you regularly visit 'The No.1 Gaming Forum,' you must have heard of the famous moderator 'Super Meow Guardian,' who posts game guides and news...

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿嘿，你应该猜不到，其实那个人就是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, you'd never guess, but that person is actually...

TextContext.SourceString: 那个人是谁？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who is it?

TextContext.SourceString: 哎，猜不出来吗？大概这就是“真人不露相”吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You don't know, do you? I guess it’s true what they say, looks can be deceiving.

TextContext.SourceString: 难道是你？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is it you?

TextContext.SourceString: 这么快就被你发现了吗？你果然慧眼如炬啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: How did you figure it out so quickly? You really do have a sharp eye!

TextContext.SourceString: 那么，我们再来互相认识一下吧，在工作时间内我是搜查官，但平日里，我是作为游戏玩家的米雪儿，游戏ID是“超级喵喵卫士”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm, let's get to know each other a bit better, shall we? I work as an investigator, but off the clock, I'm just Michele, the gamer. My ID is Super Pawtector.

TextContext.SourceString: 玩家的属性搭配搜查官的身份，会不会觉得有点不搭调呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: An investigator by day, a gamer by night. Does that sound a bit odd to you?

TextContext.SourceString: 但这就是我，励志做一个玩家式的酷炫搜查官！
TextContext.LocalizedString: But hey, that's me—on a mission to be a super cool, gamer-style investigator!

TextContext.SourceString: 引航者，现在是难得的自由休息时间，有兴趣进行一场属于玩家的挑战吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, Navigator! We've got some rare free time. Fancy a challenge between gamers?

TextContext.SourceString: 有望冲击“年度最佳剧情”的推理游戏《纸飞姬侦探》，延续了童年情怀的经典动作游戏《NO.1的正义英雄》，哪一个你更有兴趣呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: You can choose between Paper Detective, a contender for Best Story of the Year, or Superheroes of Justice, a classic action game filled with childhood nostalgia. Which adventure are you up for?

TextContext.SourceString: 《纸飞姬侦探》！
TextContext.LocalizedString: "Paper Detective!"

TextContext.SourceString: 这款新作是根据同名电视剧改编的文字冒险游戏，剧情跌宕起伏、悬念环环相扣，搜查科的长官们也向我们推荐呢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This one's based on the hit TV series, a text adventure with twists and turns that'll keep you hooked. Even our chief investigators are recommending it.

TextContext.SourceString: 正好长官们给我们发放了免费的游戏卡带，一起来体验下做“大侦探”的感觉吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: And guess what? They gave it to us for free. Let's dive in and see what it feels like to be a "Great Detective"!

TextContext.SourceString: 《NO.1的正义英雄》！
TextContext.LocalizedString: "Superheroes of Justice!"

TextContext.SourceString: 这个系列在旧地球就超有人气呢，它是一款需要双人协作的角色扮演游戏。
TextContext.LocalizedString: This was a big hit back on Old Earth, a co-op RPG that's all about teamwork.

TextContext.SourceString: 考验我们配合的时候到了，让我来看看引航者的游戏技术怎么样~
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's time to find out how well we work together as a team. Show me what you've got, Navigator!

TextContext.SourceString: 原来我还有一点点担心，引航者不喜欢游戏该怎么办呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I was a tad worried that you might not be into video games...

TextContext.SourceString: 那从现在起，你就是我的游戏伙伴啦~这是你的游戏手柄，调试一下摇杆的手感以及快捷按键吧。
TextContext.LocalizedString: But now that you're onboard, you're officially my gaming partner! Here's your controller; take a moment to get a feel for the joystick and the quick buttons.

TextContext.SourceString: 好久没有在家里和别人打游戏了，你说，由搜查官与引航者共同经历的冒险故事，会不会特别有趣呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's been ages since I've gamed with someone at home. What do you think? A story of adventures shared by an investigator and a navigator sounds pretty exciting, right?

TextContext.SourceString: （数日后，商业街，天气晴朗。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A few days later, the sun's shining bright over the commercial hub.)

TextContext.SourceString: （事先没有进行任何工作预约，米雪儿神秘兮兮地把我约了出来。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With no work planned, Michele unexpectedly invites me out for a secret rendezvous.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，今天有没有兴趣解锁埃利蒙德的“隐藏地图”？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey partner, how about we unlock a "hidden location" in Elmond today?

TextContext.SourceString: 正好现在你和我都不处于工作时间，咱们索性把工作通通甩开！——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Since both of us are off-duty, let's just forget about work for once!

TextContext.SourceString: 今天你很神秘的样子。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You seem rather mysterious today.

TextContext.SourceString: 要的就是这股神秘感！待会儿到了你就知道了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's exactly what I'm going for! You'll know when we get there!

TextContext.SourceString: （小声）这个地方——我只带你一个人来过喔~所以务必要保密哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Whispering) You're the only person I've ever brought to this place. So keep it a secret, okay?

TextContext.SourceString: （俏皮的少女牵着我的手，雀跃着走进了一家温馨舒适的咖啡厅，店内休憩着慵懒的猫咪。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Michele leads me by the hand into a cozy café filled with the lazy ambiance of lounging cats.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿嘿，这里就是我的秘密基地啦！——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, welcome to my secret base!

TextContext.SourceString: 这里是整个埃利蒙德唯一与NO.1系列联名的猫咖店，是NO.1系列粉丝线下聚会的首选之地！
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is the only cat café in all of Elmond that's teamed up with the "Superheroes of Justice" series. It's the ultimate fan meetup spot!

TextContext.SourceString: 哎呀呀，好痒好痒……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whoa, that tickles!

TextContext.SourceString: （几只俏皮的猫咪不请自来，任性地在米雪儿四周泼皮打闹。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Several playful cats approach uninvited, frolicking around Michele.)

TextContext.SourceString: （这些猫咪似乎每一只都和她很熟悉。被毛球包裹的少女完全放下了她的狡黠与神秘。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It seems she's familiar with each of these cats. Surrounded by a flurry of fur, Michele drops her act of mystery and wit.)

TextContext.SourceString: 看着这些小家伙，我忽然想起了我家里的那两个孩子，火力大喵和喵喵卫士！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Watching these little ones reminds me of Mighty Meow and Pawtector!

TextContext.SourceString: 它们的名字好像有点特别……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Their names are pretty unique...

TextContext.SourceString: 你注意到了啊？《NO.1的正义英雄》的两位主角也叫火力大喵和喵喵卫士。但实际上，和这款游戏最有渊源的是——我的搜查官老爸，搜查科的一线英雄。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You've noticed, huh? They're named after the two protagonists of Superheroes of Justice. But actually, it's my dad, the hero from the investigation unit, who's the real connection to this game.

TextContext.SourceString: 在来到卡丘世界之前，我的父亲就长年坚守前线，他是作为英雄被邀请到欧泊的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: My father served on the frontline for years before coming to Strinova. He was invited to join P.U.S as a hero.

TextContext.SourceString: 我是在某次搜集攻略时无意中得知的，原来这款游戏是根据我父亲过去的英雄事迹改编的！其中，斩龙少年“火力大喵”的原型就是他！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I only found out about this by accident while reading game guides. Turns out, the story of the game was inspired by my father's heroic deeds! The dragon-slaying Mighty Meow was based on him!

TextContext.SourceString: 原来是这样！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wow, that's incredible!

TextContext.SourceString: 你的父亲是一位英雄！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your father is a hero!

TextContext.SourceString: 对，他一直都是。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yup, he always has been.

TextContext.SourceString: 在此之前，我只是把父亲当作是我的游戏伙伴……在我小的时候，父亲平时很忙，但一有空了就常常带着我和机器猫们一起体验游戏……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Before all of this, I just saw my dad as my gaming buddy... When I was little, he was always busy, but whenever he had time, he'd play games with me and our robot kitties.

TextContext.SourceString: 他就像游戏里的“大喵”一样，手持巨剑，总是走在我前面，而我是那只拿着盾牌的“小喵”，安全地躲在他的身后。
TextContext.LocalizedString: He was like Mighty Meow from the game, wielding a giant sword and always leading the way. I was the Pawtector, the little one with the shield, safely hiding behind him.

TextContext.SourceString: 后来父亲不幸染上了崩溃症，就再也没有人陪我一起玩游戏了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Then my dad tragically fell ill with Collapse Syndrome, and I lost my gaming partner...

TextContext.SourceString: 不知不觉，我从游戏中学会了玩家思维，甚至直接代入了我的工作中……也因此我变得和别人不一样，总是遭遇同事排挤或上级训斥。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Without realizing it, I adopted a gamer's mindset and started applying it directly to my work... It made me different, which led to colleagues shunning me and criticism from superiors.

TextContext.SourceString: 我原先一直在困惑，到底是做一名酷酷的玩家？还是做一名规矩的搜查官？
TextContext.LocalizedString: I used to be confused—should I be a cool gamer or a by-the-book investigator?

TextContext.SourceString: 你现在有答案了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Have you found your answer now?

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯，我有了一个属于自己的答案……这个答案，我只想对你一人诉说。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yeah, I have an answer that's just my own... One which I'll only share with you.

TextContext.SourceString: （此时，毛茸茸、圆滚滚的毛球们无一不紧挨着我们，反复在我们之间穿梭，央求抚摸与拥抱。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The fluffy, round furballs snuggle up to us, weaving in and out between us, meowing for pats and hugs.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，这些猫咪也很喜欢你喔~它们把你当作猫群中的一份子了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: These cats have taken a liking to you, partner! They see you as one of their own now!

TextContext.SourceString: 现在的我已经不再孤单一人了呢，我遇见了引航者，我有了新的游戏伙伴！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I am no longer alone because I've met you, Navigator, and now I have a new gaming buddy!

TextContext.SourceString: 我发现，无论是作为玩家，还是搜查官，二者并不矛盾，无论哪一面，都是专属于我的特质。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've realized that there's no conflict between being a gamer and an investigator. Both of them are my unique traits.

TextContext.SourceString: 无论哪一面，我都不想轻易放弃呢，可能这就是我，一名独一无二的超级玩家搜查官！
TextContext.LocalizedString: And I don't want to give up on either of them. Maybe that's who I am, a one-of-a-kind super gamer investigator!

TextContext.SourceString: 说出来可能有点难为情……我也希望能像英雄老爸那样成为游戏主角的原型。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It might be a bit embarrassing to admit, but I want to become a hero that will influence games, just like my dad.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是，仅有我一个人是不够的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But I can't do it alone...

TextContext.SourceString: （少女澄澈的眼睛里饱含笑意，此时此刻无比认真地注视着我。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her clear eyes are filled with warmth as she looks at me earnestly.)

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟主角也是需要同伴的嘛，对吧，我最好的游戏伙伴？
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all, even a hero needs sidekicks, right, partner?

TextContext.SourceString: 让我来做你的“大喵”吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll be your Mighty Meow!

TextContext.SourceString: 你就是那只“小喵”？
TextContext.LocalizedString: And you'll be... Pawtector?

TextContext.SourceString: 哎嘿嘿……我们之间的默契真是心照不宣啊~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Aww, we're perfectly in sync!

TextContext.SourceString: 咳咳，现在我的心愿要稍稍修订一下，我希望我们两个都能成为未来续作的原型……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, time to amend my wish a bit. I hope both of us can become the prototypes that will inspire a future sequel...

TextContext.SourceString: 决定了！下一代《NO.1的正义英雄》的主角就是了不起的引航者和了不起的搜查官！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's settled, then! The heroes of the next "Superheroes of Justice" will be the amazing Navigator and the incredible Investigator!

TextContext.SourceString: （在猫咪们的陪伴中，和米雪儿一起一直待到了晚上。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Surrounded by cats, we stayed together at the café until late in the evening.)

TextContext.SourceString: （过了整整一天，米雪儿的脸上也没露出一丝疲惫。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (After spending an entire day, Michele doesn't seem tired at all.)

PrologueTitle.SourceString: 玩家思维还是规行矩步？
PrologueTitle.LocalizedString: Gamer Instinct or Play by the Rules?

TextContext.SourceString: （休息日，格兰德海滩边。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's a day off at Grand Beach.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，你知道吗？当你心中充满苦闷时，就可以奔赴海边，让海风带走你的烦恼。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey partner, did you know? When you're feeling overwhelmed, heading to the beach and letting the sea breeze carry your worries away can work wonders.

TextContext.SourceString: 乌拉乌拉，烦恼消散！海风啊，让我暂时忘掉写检讨的痛苦吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whoosh, whoosh, troubles be gone! Oh, sea breeze, please help me forget the pain of writing self-reports!

TextContext.SourceString: 你又违背纪律了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Did you break the rules again?

TextContext.SourceString: 哎哎哎，能不能先别提那些烦心事啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come on, let's not talk about that here...

TextContext.SourceString: 遇到什么烦心事了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's troubling you?

TextContext.SourceString: 厉害了，我的伙伴，你会读心术吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wow, partner, can you read minds or something?

TextContext.SourceString: 我知道你在关心我啦……没什么大不了的事，日常挨训罢了。对我来说，都是家常便饭了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I know you're looking out for me... It's nothing, really. I'm used to being scolded...

TextContext.SourceString: （往常如同猫咪般活泼的女孩此刻元气值处于断电的状态。她有意回避我的视线，似乎不愿被人看透她的心思。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The girl, usually as playful as a kitty, seems to have lost all her energy. She deliberately avoids making eye contact, not wanting to share her feelings with me.)

TextContext.SourceString: 这次没有那么简单吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't think it's as simple as that this time...

TextContext.SourceString: ……好吧，什么都逃不过你的眼睛。
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Okay, okay. Ugh! I can't hide anything from you.

TextContext.SourceString: 其实是因为……在上一次作战任务中，我违反纪律，抄了近道去突袭敌人。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So... during my last mission, I broke the rules and took a shortcut to ambush the enemy.

TextContext.SourceString: 眼看我就要得手了，没想到后来中了埋伏，目标也跟丢了，我的“玩家思维”也不是每次都灵验的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Just when I thought I had them, I walked right into a trap and lost my target. My gamer's mindset doesn't work every time...

TextContext.SourceString: 不出意料地，执行长官们“又”给我布置了十几页的检讨书工作……但是这一次不同，长官们说，如果累计违纪次数过多……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Unsurprisingly, my superiors punished me with another stack of self-reflection papers... But this time, it's different. They mentioned that if my violations keep piling up...

TextContext.SourceString: 看起来后果很严重的样子……
TextContext.LocalizedString: That sounds pretty serious...

TextContext.SourceString: 最终可能会面临“停职”处分！——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I might actually face a "suspension"!

TextContext.SourceString: 哈哈哈，那也是你活该！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha-ha-ha, serves you right!

TextContext.SourceString: （一名正在执行巡查任务的欧泊搜查官愤愤地走来，一脸不屑地看着我们。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A P.U.S investigator on patrol walks over angrily, glaring at us with disdain.)

TextContext.SourceString: 欸？我好像见过这个人，他是“搜查二班”刚刚转正的搜查官，是我在搜查官学院的后辈。在学院的时候，我和他被分到同一组，共同参加作战演习。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? I think I know him. He's a junior investigator who just made the cut into Bravo Team. We were in the same group for a training exercise back at the academy.

TextContext.SourceString: 少用前辈自居了，你这家伙！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stop acting like you're some big shot elite!

TextContext.SourceString: 上一次和你合作，我吃了不少苦头！你三番五次无视纪律，贸然行动，破坏搜查官的形象，早该停职了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Last time I teamed up with you, I had nothing but trouble! You ignored the rules over and over, acted recklessly and tarnished our reputation. You should have been suspended long ago!

TextContext.SourceString: 请注意你的发言！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Watch your words!

TextContext.SourceString: 不许你污蔑我的同伴！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Enough of your petty insults!

TextContext.SourceString: 你和她是一伙的吗？跟着这样冒失的家伙一起行动，早晚会遭遇不幸的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're sticking up for her? Partnering with such a reckless fool is only going to get you in trouble!

TextContext.SourceString: （我的愤怒无以言表，但是米雪儿拉住了我的手，她似乎对这种情形表现得很淡然。这些流言蜚语是她需要经常面对的吗？）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (I'm beyond angry, but Michele grabs my hand, staying calm. Is this kind of gossip something she deals with often?)

TextContext.SourceString: 这家伙的父亲原先是搜查科的“大英雄”，在埃利蒙德颇具盛名，但那件事你应该知道了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Her father was once the hero of the Investigation Bureau, known all across Elmond. But you know about the incident, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 搜查科已经下达了对她父亲的处分通知，因为他在欧拉港口行动中办案不力，害得搜查科损失了大量人力，现在执行长官们决定暂停他的前线职务。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The Bureau already disciplined him. During the Port Euler operation, he made some serious mistakes, causing a lot of casualties. They’ve decided to suspend him from frontline duties.

TextContext.SourceString: 这样鲁莽而没有实力的人，算什么英雄！
TextContext.LocalizedString: How can someone so reckless and incompetent be called a hero?

TextContext.SourceString: 你住口！——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Shut your mouth!

TextContext.SourceString: 老爸他才不是那样的人！他为了保护同伴身负重伤，才被调离了前线，不是因为办案不力！
TextContext.LocalizedString: My dad’s not like that! He got seriously injured protecting his team, and that’s the only reason he was pulled from the frontlines. It had nothing to do with his handling of the case!

TextContext.SourceString: 他虽然负伤倒下了，但在我心里，他一直是一个英雄！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even though he's injured now, he’ll always be my hero!

TextContext.SourceString: 哈哈哈，反正他已经是废人一个了，他还怎么做英雄？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha-ha! You’d call a cripple a hero?

TextContext.SourceString: （对方尖酸刻薄的语气丝毫没有收敛，远处忽然有人叫喊这个人的名字，他应声后乐呵呵地跑开了。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The man doesn’t dial down his sarcastic tone one bit. Suddenly, someone calls out for him in the distance, and he cheerfully runs off.)

TextContext.SourceString: （米雪儿与我坐在海滩边，我们二人相对无言，只听得见海潮往复的声音。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Michele and I sit by the edge of the beach, silently facing each other as the sound of the waves ebb and flow around us.)

TextContext.SourceString: （失落的女孩取出了一枚熠熠生辉的徽章，上面印有欧泊的标识，一柄正义利剑横贯其中，历任欧泊搜查官的英勇与坚毅仿佛凝聚于此。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A disheartened Michele pulls out a gleaming badge bearing the P.U.S insignia with a sword of justice cutting across it—a testament to the bravery and resolve of every P.U.S Investigator that came before her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，你知道吗？作为一名搜查官佩戴上这枚徽章，是目前为止，最令我自豪的一件事……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, you know what? Wearing this badge as an investigator is the thing I'm most proud of…

TextContext.SourceString: 我终于能像那名“英雄”一样，换上一身搜查官制服，帅气地踏上战场同敌人作战。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It means I can finally put on the investigator's uniform and step onto the battlefield with valor, just like that "hero" I always admired.

TextContext.SourceString: 那名“英雄”是谁？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Who is this hero you speak of?

TextContext.SourceString: 就是我的搜查官老爸……他在欧拉港口行动中负伤倒下了，现在这枚徽章上承载的东西，只能由我来维护了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: It’s my dad… He was injured during the Port Euler operation, leaving me to uphold the legacy of this badge.

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，刚刚我仔细地想了想，我想做一个重大决定……
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, after giving it a lot of thought just now, I've decided I’m going to make a big change...

TextContext.SourceString: 我想暂时放下“玩家思维”，尝试做一个规矩听话的搜查官。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm going to set aside my gamer's mindset for now and try being a well-disciplined investigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 失去一个游戏伙伴，我会很伤心的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm going to be sad to lose my gaming buddy...

TextContext.SourceString: 作为“游戏玩家”有什么不好吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's wrong with being a gamer?

TextContext.SourceString: 谢谢你，伙伴……看起来作为“游戏玩家”的米雪儿也是有人在乎的嘛~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Thanks, partner... It's nice to know that at least one person cares about gamer Michele.

TextContext.SourceString: 我想试着做一个和大家一样的人，一个严明守纪的人。这样，关于老爸和我的流言蜚语也就能少一些，老爸的“英雄之名”也就不再会受到他人玷污。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I want to be someone who sticks to the rules, just like everyone else. Maybe then, the rumors about my dad and me will fade away, and his "hero" status won't be tarnished anymore.

TextContext.SourceString: ……再者，一直冒冒失失、违反纪律，我的搜查官之位可能也不保了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Besides, if I keep being reckless and breaking the rules, I might end up losing my job...

TextContext.SourceString: 所以，做出这个决定，我可是很认真的喔！
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, I'm really serious about this decision!

TextContext.SourceString: （金色的阳光下，背对着澎湃翻腾的浪潮，少女海蓝色的眼眸里闪烁着坚毅。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Bathed in golden sunlight, her ocean-blue eyes shimmer with determination as the waves crash behind her.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不过在此之前，我们要好好地和过去告别。伙伴，不介意再和我来一场玩家对战吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: But before that, we need a proper farewell to the past. Care to join me for one last battle?

TextContext.SourceString: （又是一个休息日，米雪儿邀请我到熟悉的欧泊1号公寓。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's another day off, and Michele has invited me over to her apartment.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我隔着门就能听到少女在哼唱NO.1系列的主题曲。明明是热血欢快的曲调，哼唱者却似乎意志消沉。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Through the door, I can hear her humming the theme song from the No.1 series. It's an upbeat tune, but her voice carries a hint of gloominess.)

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，伙伴，你来了啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, hey! You're here.

TextContext.SourceString: 呃呃呃，我是因为什么把你叫过来的？……请提醒我一下，我最近比较健忘。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ugh, remind me why I called you over? I've been a bit forgetful lately.

TextContext.SourceString: 因为今天是你的生日！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's your birthday today!

TextContext.SourceString: 是嘛？可是今天不是我的生日啊……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But today's not my birthday...

TextContext.SourceString: 我也不记得了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can't remember either.

TextContext.SourceString: 那可糟糕了……我们都再努力回忆一下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh no, we've got to think harder...

TextContext.SourceString: 是新游戏的发售日！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The new game will be released today!

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，就是这个！我想起来了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes, that's it! I remember now!

TextContext.SourceString: 唔……没错没错，今天是《NO.1的正义英雄》的新作发售日！上周我在赫尔墨斯商城预订好了游戏碟片。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm... That's right. The latest installment of Superheroes of Justice will be released today! I pre-ordered it at the mall last week.

TextContext.SourceString: 根据最新的物流动态，今天应该就能送货上门。等碟片到了，我们可以一起体验一下。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Based on the latest update, it should be delivered today. Let's play it together once it arrives.

TextContext.SourceString: 今天把引航者伙伴叫过来，应该就是为了这个吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: That must be why I invited you...

TextContext.SourceString: （一向元气的少女话语里透露着无尽的疲惫。似曾相识的一幕，猫一般的女孩又在回避我的目光。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The usually energetic girl sounds exhausted. It's a scene I've seen before, like a cat avoiding my gaze.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，你有什么烦恼吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is something bothering you?

TextContext.SourceString: ……唔，我的心思又被你看透了吗……
TextContext.LocalizedString: …Sigh, you saw through me again...

TextContext.SourceString: 是不是又有事情瞒着我了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you hiding something from me?

TextContext.SourceString: 呃呃呃，我我我……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Uh, ummm, I-I-I...

TextContext.SourceString: ……你别再盯着我看了，我脸上没有东西的……唔，好吧，我老实交代！
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Stop staring at me, there's nothing on my face... Fine. I'll tell you!

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，老实说，你在察言观色、洞察人心方面真的很有潜质，堪比专业的搜查官了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Honestly, partner, you have a great knack for reading between the lines and understanding people, almost as good as a professional investigator.

TextContext.SourceString: 咳咳，其实嘛……上次游戏厅蚀质流事故，上级长官们部分认可了我的临场发挥，他们认为，以群众的安全为先进行疏散撤离是值得肯定的。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So, here's the thing... after the arcade incident, my superiors somewhat acknowledged my improvisation. They thought prioritizing the evacuation of the public was commendable.

TextContext.SourceString: 但是，未经上报就擅自使用游戏模型撤离群众，没有严格执行封锁指令，是非常严重的违纪行为，可能会引发诸多无法预料的危机。
TextContext.LocalizedString: However, I dismantled the prop shield without prior authorization and failed to strictly follow the lock-down order, which constitutes a serious breach of discipline, potentially leading to unforeseen crises.

TextContext.SourceString: 总而言之，功过相抵，我还是要写十几页的检讨书……写检讨真是我人生中逃离不了的灾难啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Long story short, I'm still stuck writing dozens of pages of self-reflection... It seems like I can never get away from them!

TextContext.SourceString: 执行长官们什么时候能变得开明一些？据说，他们今天还打算组团进行上门教育……可恶，偏偏是今天，刚好赶上了游戏发售日！
TextContext.LocalizedString: When will my superiors become more open-minded? Apparently, they're planning to visit today for some "educational" talk. Why must it be today of all days? I just want to play the new game in peace! Ugh!!!

TextContext.SourceString: （就在少女发愁嘀咕之际，门外忽然响起了一阵匆忙而尖锐的敲门声。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Just as she's muttering her worries, there's a sudden, sharp knock at the door.)

TextContext.SourceString: 唔，怎么回事？！——
TextContext.LocalizedString: What's going on?!

TextContext.SourceString: 长官们已经到了吗？！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are your superiors here already?!

TextContext.SourceString: 呜呜，你别吓我啊！！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ahh, don't scare me like that!!

TextContext.SourceString: 我刚刚的吐槽不会全被听到了吧？怎么办、怎么办！肯定又少不了一顿训斥……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Do you think they heard my rant just now? What do I do, what do I do! I'm definitely in for another lecture...

TextContext.SourceString: 有没有可能是游戏碟片到了？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Perhaps it's the courier?

TextContext.SourceString: 真、真的吗？真的不是长官他们在敲门吗……
TextContext.LocalizedString: R-Really? Not my superiors?

TextContext.SourceString: 唔……伙伴，你说的有道理，肯定是游戏碟片到了！不是长官、不是长官！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hmm... You've got a point. My game must've arrived! And it's definitely not my superiors!

TextContext.SourceString: （松口气）呼——让我稍微缓一缓……嗯嗯，我已经做好了开门的心理准备！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whew—let me catch my breath for a second... Okay, I’m ready to open the door!

TextContext.SourceString: 不管门后是什么，赶紧放马过来吧——
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whoever it is, bring it on!

TextContext.SourceString: （鼓足勇气的少女猛地打开了门，门后除了《NO.1的正义英雄》新作的游戏碟片，还有一份额外的神秘包裹，寄件人不明。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Mustering her courage, Michele flings the door open. Behind it lies not only the new disc of "Superheroes of Justice," but also a mysterious package.)

TextContext.SourceString: （米雪儿屏住呼吸，小心翼翼地拆开包裹，里面是一个塞满猫爪饼干的游戏奖杯。除此外，包裹里还附带了一封感谢信。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Holding her breath, Michele carefully unwraps the package, revealing a game trophy filled with cat paw cookies. Alongside it is a thank you letter.)

TextContext.SourceString: （信件的内容是，“致勇敢帅气的猫咪搜查官，这是所有玩家共同预订的纪念奖杯，将这份荣耀赠予你，你的勇敢坚毅如同游戏中的勇者一般。”）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The letter reads, "To the brave and charming Cat Investigator, this commemorative trophy is from all the players. It is our pleasure to bestow this honor upon you, whose courage and perseverance echo the heroes in our games.")

TextContext.SourceString: （信件的末尾处落款了许多人的名字，最后还标注了这样一句话，“附赠大喵电玩厅联名款猫爪饼干，好吃的话记得预订哦~”）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Many names are signed at the bottom of the letter, followed by a note: “Included are the Mighty Meow Arcade co-branded cat paw cookies. If you like the cookies, don't forget to preorder more.”)

TextContext.SourceString: 是米雪儿的玩家思维拯救了大家！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It was your gamer instincts that saved everyone!

TextContext.SourceString: 真的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Really?

TextContext.SourceString: 这是第一次、第一次因为“玩家作风”而收获他人的感谢……我原来那么厉害的吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: This is literally the first time someone has thanked me for my gamer's mindset... Am I really that incredible?

TextContext.SourceString: 请相信自己，搜查官米雪儿。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Believe in yourself!

TextContext.SourceString: 你可是超酷的游戏伙伴啊！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're the coolest gaming partner ever!

TextContext.SourceString: （小声）这样的我，是不是能像老爸一样成为英雄呢……这样的话，老爸的意志也就不会消失了吧……
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Whispering) Maybe I can become a hero like my dad... If so, his legacy will live on, right?

TextContext.SourceString: （米雪儿喃喃自语，将奖杯摆放到了剑与盾的模型旁边，三个摆件如同她珍贵的“成就奖杯”，在阳光下愈发耀眼夺目。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Muttering to herself, Michele places the trophy next to the sword and shield models. The three items act as her achievement trophies, shining brightly under the sunlight.)

TextContext.SourceString: （另一边的我已经放好了游戏碟片，拿起手柄准备开始游戏，但米雪儿迟迟不过来，呆呆地凝视着那些宝贵的“奖杯”。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Meanwhile, I've set up the new game and grabbed the controller, ready to dive in, but Michele stands there, lost in thought, gazing at her precious "trophies.")

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，准备好了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you ready?

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，就来、就来！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh. Yeah, I'm coming!

TextContext.SourceString: 对了，这些可爱的猫爪饼干，就在我们体验新作的时候一同享用吧~
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's enjoy these cute cat paw cookies as we play the game!

TextContext.SourceString: 等候多时了，属于引航者和搜查官的全新冒险，即将启程！——
TextContext.LocalizedString: At long last, our new adventure is about to begin!

TextContext.SourceString: （约定的当日，商业街——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The day of our meeting arrives at the bustling commercial hub.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呀哈——！伙伴，你来了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Heyyy! You made it, partner!

TextContext.SourceString: 准备好……和我做最终的胜负了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you ready... for our ultimate showdown?

TextContext.SourceString: （米雪儿一如既往地兴高采烈，就像是这只是一场普通的游戏对局一样。但语气中的不甘心和落寞，任谁都能察觉出来吧。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As always, Michele is full of enthusiasm, as if it’s just another typical gaming session. But anyone can sense the underlying reluctance and sadness in her tone.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我还没有准备好哦。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I’m not quite ready yet.

TextContext.SourceString: 哼哼，那看起来我今天的胜率应该会很高呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haha, then it looks like my chances of winning are pretty high today!

TextContext.SourceString: 这样就能不留遗憾了……吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: This way, there won’t be any regrets... right?

TextContext.SourceString: 放马过来吧！米雪儿！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Bring it on, Michele!

TextContext.SourceString: 咦咦咦！？这么快？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh? So soon?

TextContext.SourceString: 我、我可还没准备好……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I-I’m not ready yet...

TextContext.SourceString: 总之马上就快到游戏厅了！超级玩家的告别战即将开始了哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The arcade is just up ahead! The farewell match of the ultimate gamer is about to begin!

TextContext.SourceString: 这样未免也太遗憾了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Our gaming adventures are coming to an end...

TextContext.SourceString: 你可是我最好的开黑朋友。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I can't believe I'm going to lose my best gaming buddy...

TextContext.SourceString: 你！你这是分心计！我是不会中计的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't try to distract me! I won't fall for it!

TextContext.SourceString: 让我们开始吧，今天一定要痛痛快快地打一场！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's get started. This is going to be the battle to end all battles!

TextContext.SourceString: 好了，快点让我们……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Alright, shall we...

TextContext.SourceString: （一阵急促的警铃声从米雪儿的便携通信装置中传出。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (A sudden blaring alarm rings from Michele's portable communicator.)

TextContext.SourceString: 哎？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh?

TextContext.SourceString: 啧！偏偏在这个时候……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Seriously? Now of all times...

TextContext.SourceString: 警情通报！埃利蒙德东2区卡普里维大街30号发生了蚀质流灾害，请附近警员迅速响应！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Attention all units! Erosion hazard was reported at 30 Caprivi Street, Area 2, Elmond East. Requesting immediate response!

TextContext.SourceString: 卡普里维大街30号……等等，那不就是……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: 30 Caprivi Street... Wait, isn't that…!

TextContext.SourceString: 游戏厅！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The arcade!

TextContext.SourceString: 没错！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Exactly!

TextContext.SourceString: 就是我们现在所在的地方！
TextContext.LocalizedString: That's where we are right now!

TextContext.SourceString: 蚀质流灾害？很糟糕吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: An erosion hazard? Is it serious?

TextContext.SourceString: 是很危险的情况啊！蚀质是弦化过程中产生的有害液体！随便接触会害死人的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's extremely dangerous! Erosion substances are a type of harmful liquid produced during stringification! Contact with it is lethal!

TextContext.SourceString: 平时都是会被管理排污的，对局暂停！我必须……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Usually, it's managed and contained. Pause the match! I must...

TextContext.SourceString: （抓住米雪儿的手。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Grab Michele’s hand)

TextContext.SourceString: 哎？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Huh?

TextContext.SourceString: 我会做你的“大喵”。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll be your Mighty Meow.

TextContext.SourceString: …我明白了，我们一起！
TextContext.LocalizedString: ...Alright, we’ll do this together!

TextContext.SourceString: 呼叫总部，这里是搜查官米雪儿，编号44061！我已赶到蚀质流灾害发生地点，请指示！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Come in, HQ. This is Investigator Michele, ID 44061. I've arrived at the erosion hazard site. Please advise! Over.

TextContext.SourceString: 搜查官米雪儿，请立刻封锁现场，等待后续警员携带蚀质收集装置赶到。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Investigator Michele, lock down and secure the site immediately. Await backup with erosion containment equipment. Over.

TextContext.SourceString: 了解！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Roger!

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿，你看！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Michele, look!

TextContext.SourceString: 呼叫总部，这里是搜查官米雪儿，现场有受困群众，请指示！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Calling HQ, this is Investigator Michele, we have civilians trapped on site. Please advise! Over.

TextContext.SourceString: 搜查官米雪儿，请完成你的职责，封锁现场，防止蚀质流扩散，等待指示！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Investigator, fulfill your duty and lock down the site. Prevent the spread of the erosion flow and await further instructions! Over.

TextContext.SourceString: 总部！总部！
TextContext.LocalizedString: HQ! Come on, HQ!

TextContext.SourceString: 通讯被切断了……！
TextContext.LocalizedString: The comms have been cut off...!

TextContext.SourceString: （蓝紫色的液体不断地外溢着，哪怕是游戏厅之外也能感受到事情变得不断严重。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The blue-purple liquid keeps spilling out. Even standing outside the arcade, the gravity of the situation is worsening by the minute.)

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么办，里面的玩家怎么办，我现在什么办法都没有……！难道就要看着……
TextContext.LocalizedString: What do I do? What about the players trapped inside? I feel so powerless... I can't just stand by and watch...

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Michele!

TextContext.SourceString: 想想你是谁！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Remember who you are!

TextContext.SourceString: 我是搜查官米雪儿——
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm an Investigator of P.U.S!

TextContext.SourceString: （她抬起了头，与我四目相对，湛蓝的眼眸无比清澈。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (She lifts her gaze, locking eyes with me, her crystal blue eyes sharpened with resolve.)

TextContext.SourceString: 也是超级玩家米雪儿！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm also the super gamer Michele!

TextContext.SourceString: （那可爱的眸子里逐渐燃起了斗志，迸发着意志的火花。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Determination ignites in those adorable eyes, sparking with fierce will.)

TextContext.SourceString: 别的搜查官想不到的，我肯定会……有了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll come up with something no other investigator would think of... Yes, I've got it!

TextContext.SourceString: （米雪儿的身影几乎在我眼前瞬间消失，奔向游戏厅门前。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Michele vanishes before my eyes, rushing to the arcade entrance.)

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey!

TextContext.SourceString: （随着一阵嘎巴嘎巴的声音，门口用于游戏宣传的道具盾被她拆在了手里。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (With a series of clattering sounds, she dismantles the promotional prop shield at the entrance.)

TextContext.SourceString: 我来了！坚持住！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm coming in! Hang in there!

TextContext.SourceString: （冲入现场的米雪儿将盾牌进行了弦化，抵挡着喷涌而出的蚀质流。那姿态像是照亮希望的一束微光一般。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Charging into the scene, Michele stringifies the shield, using it to block the gushing erosion flow. Her stance is like a beacon of hope illuminating the darkness.)

TextContext.SourceString: 搜查官米雪儿，前来救援!
TextContext.LocalizedString: Investigator Michele coming to your rescue!

TextContext.SourceString: （虽然在远处看不真切，但米雪儿的勇敢的声音，即便是站在这里也能听得一清二楚。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Even from a distance, Michele's courageous voice rings out loud and clear.)

TextContext.SourceString: （手持盾牌的娇小身影抵挡着蓝紫色的浊流，就像是对抗巨龙火焰的勇者一样。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her petite frame, wielding the shield, stands firm against the blue-purple torrent, like a hero facing down a dragon's flames.)

TextContext.SourceString: 不要慌，快点离开这里！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Stay calm and get to the exit!

TextContext.SourceString: （获得生机的人们虽然依旧惊恐万分，但在米雪儿的支持下立刻动了起来。随着人们从游戏厅中不断涌出，但始终不见米雪儿的身影撤离。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Though still terrified, the people trapped inside start moving with Michele's encouragement. As they pour out of the arcade, Michele is nowhere to be seen.)

TextContext.SourceString: （蓝紫色的浊流已经将那反抗的小小勇者吞噬。所有人似乎都以为再也无法看懂那束光的时候——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The blue-purple torrent had seemingly swallowed the brave little hero. Everyone feared that the light of hope had been extinguished—)

TextContext.SourceString: （那身影却在大家的面前再度出现！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But then, Michele reappears out of nowhere!)

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Michele!

TextContext.SourceString: 来啦来啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm here!

TextContext.SourceString: （在所有人的目光下，米雪儿的身影从滚滚浓烟中缓缓走出。一张花猫脸上全是脏污，但有着污渍无法遮蔽的笑容。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Amidst everyone's gaze, Michele emerges slowly from the thick smoke. Her face is covered in ash, but beneath the grime, her smile shines as bright as ever.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那身可爱的休闲服似乎也有几分破损，看起来颇显狼狈。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Her cute casual outfit looks a bit tattered, adding a touch of scrappiness to her appearance.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是，她现在却像是凯旋的勇士一样光彩照人。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But now, she glows like a triumphant hero.)

TextContext.SourceString: 抱歉，让你担心了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Sorry. You must have been worried.

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么可能不担心呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: How could I not?

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿嘿，现在想来还有点后怕就是了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, now that I think about it, it was pretty scary.

TextContext.SourceString: 毕竟我们的对决还没开始！
TextContext.LocalizedString: After all, our showdown still hasn't begun!

TextContext.SourceString: 要是我现在就挂了，那也太可惜了吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: It'd be a real shame if I bowed out early, right?

TextContext.SourceString: 不过按照这个样子……
TextContext.LocalizedString: But as things stand...

TextContext.SourceString: 游戏厅我看一时半会儿是去不了咯。
TextContext.LocalizedString: The arcade will probably be closed for a while.

TextContext.SourceString: 你没事就好。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm just glad you're okay.

TextContext.SourceString: 真是遗憾呢……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's such a shame...

TextContext.SourceString: 咱们的对局只能改天再战了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: We'll have to postpone our match.

TextContext.SourceString: 我随时奉陪。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm ready whenever you are.

TextContext.SourceString: 嗯！一言为定！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a deal!

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，其他搜查官来了，我得去报告情况去才行！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah, the other investigators are here—I need to brief them!

TextContext.SourceString: 没问题吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you feeling okay?

TextContext.SourceString: 当然了！我现在可是状态奇佳哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Of course! Better than ever!

TextContext.SourceString: 那我现在就……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'll get to it then...

TextContext.SourceString: 等等，米雪儿。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wait, Michele.

TextContext.SourceString: 还有什么事情吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yes?

TextContext.SourceString: （用纸巾擦去米雪儿脸上的灰尘。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Wipe the dust off Michele's face.)

TextContext.SourceString: 作为搜查官要注意形象哦？
TextContext.LocalizedString: As an investigator, you have to be mindful of your appearance.

TextContext.SourceString: 啊……那个，谢谢。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh... Right. Thanks.

TextContext.SourceString: 对决的事情，你一定要记得哦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: And don't forget about our match!

TextContext.SourceString: 你放心好了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: You got it.

TextContext.SourceString: 那……我们之后再见，我会联系你的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Until next time, then. I'll be in touch!

PrologueTitle.LocalizedString: A Day in the Life of a Gamer

TextContext.SourceString: （某日，搜查官米雪儿刚从作战任务中归来就预约了我的记录工作。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (One day, Investigator Michele schedules a briefing session with me right after returning from a mission.)

TextContext.SourceString: （我受邀前往米雪儿位于埃利蒙德的欧泊1号公寓。一打开屋门，我目睹了这番景象……）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As invited, I head to Michele's place at P.U.S. Apartment One in Elmond. The moment I open the door, an unexpected sight greets me...)

TextContext.SourceString: 火力大喵，正义执行！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Mighty Meow, execute justice!

TextContext.SourceString: 喵喵卫士，全靠你了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Don't let me down, Pawtector!

TextContext.SourceString: （被点名的两只机器猫已经困顿得不行，瘫倒在充电桩旁边呼呼大睡。在少女的脸上完全看不到疲惫，仿佛一回到纯粹美好的电子世界，她就补充满了全部活力。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (The two robot cats seem utterly exhausted, slumping beside the charging station, sound asleep. Yet Michele shows no sign of fatigue as if her energy has been completely restored the moment she steps back into the pure world of video games.)

TextContext.SourceString: 呀，伙伴！你总算来了，我等你好久了呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, partner! You’re finally here; I’ve been waiting forever!

TextContext.SourceString: 好像从没见过疲惫的米雪儿呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I don't think I've ever seen you tired, Michele!

TextContext.SourceString: 嘿嘿，这归功于我合理的元气管理。劳逸结合，张弛有度，元气就能随时保持满格啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, it’s all thanks to my strategic energy management. Work smart and play harder, and you’ll always stay energized!

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿，休息一下吧！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Take a break, Michele!

TextContext.SourceString: 我不需要休息哦！现在的我可是一点都不疲惫呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nope! I'm not tired at all!

TextContext.SourceString: 话说回来，你快看这个卡带！经过一番通宵熬夜的排队作战，我才抢到了这款掌机游戏卡带。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh, and take a look at this game! I had to queue all night for it.

TextContext.SourceString: 那个……虽然现在是伙伴的工作时间，但你有兴趣来体验一下吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Even though we should technically be working, are you up for testing it out with me?

TextContext.SourceString: （超级玩家少女的盛情难以拒绝，她的眸子里仿佛有星星在闪烁。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It's hard to refuse the invitation of a super gamer girl, especially with stars practically twinkling in her eyes.)

TextContext.SourceString: （在我准备拿起掌机时，我瞥见沙发旁的桌案上摆放了一个熟悉的东西。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As I reach for the console, something familiar catches my eye on the table beside the sofa.)

TextContext.SourceString: （那是一柄光耀闪亮的巨剑模型，做工精致，似乎很像游戏《NO.1的正义英雄》的主角火力大喵所使用的武器“光之剑”。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (It is a shining model of a giant sword, crafted with incredible detail, reminiscent of the "Sword of Light" used by Mighty Meow, the protagonist of Superheroes of Justice.)

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，你在看什么呢？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What are you looking at, partner?

TextContext.SourceString: 这是大喵的武器吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Is this Mighty Meow's weapon?

TextContext.SourceString: 你居然有绝版的“光之剑”！
TextContext.LocalizedString: You have the limited edition Sword of Light?!

TextContext.SourceString: 你怎么会知道的？难道你也是……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You know this sword? Are you also a...

TextContext.SourceString: 居然遇到了游戏同好！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Wow, a fellow fan!

TextContext.SourceString: 请保持低调……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Let's keep this between ourselves...

TextContext.SourceString: 这也太巧了吧，今天我想带伙伴玩的就是《NO.1的正义英雄》！
TextContext.LocalizedString: What a coincidence! I was actually planning to play Superheroes of Justice with you today!

TextContext.SourceString: 这款游戏，我小时候经常靠在老爸身边和他一起玩呢。我最最崇拜的角色是斩龙少年“火力大喵”！
TextContext.LocalizedString: I used to play this game with my dad all the time. My favorite character is Mighty Meow, the young dragon slayer!

TextContext.SourceString: 在我12岁那年，老爸就把大喵的武器模型当作生日礼物送给了我……时间过得真快啊，这些都是很久之前的事了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: When I was 12, my dad gave me a model of Mighty Meow's sword on my birthday... It's amazing how time flies. That feels like ages ago now.

TextContext.SourceString: 过去的事就先不提了……我们赶快开始吧，我已经迫不及待了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Enough about the past... Let's get started. I can't wait!

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，在这个游戏里，我们需要分别操控斩龙剑士“火力大喵”与巨盾少女“喵喵卫士”，击退完侵袭光之国的全部魔物就算通关了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Okay, partner, you and I will control our heroes—Mighty Meow, the dragon-slaying swordsman, and Pawtector, the shield maiden. Our mission is to defeat all the monsters invading the Kingdom of Light.

TextContext.SourceString: 目前为止，一切顺利，前面的魔物也太弱了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: So far, so good. These monsters are weak.

TextContext.SourceString: 要到第一关的最终首领了，它是潜伏在地底的九头毒龙，小心啊，伙伴！
TextContext.LocalizedString: We're coming up on the first boss now—a nine-headed venomous dragon lurking underground. Be careful, partner!

TextContext.SourceString: 就趁现在，赶快使出连携绝技“剑盾合一”！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now's our chance—let's unleash our combo move, Sword and Shield Fusion!

TextContext.SourceString: 毒龙的血条空了，我们要成功了——
TextContext.LocalizedString: The dragon's running low on HP. We're about to win!

TextContext.SourceString: 可恶，我们的技能施放被毒龙强制打断了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Argh!!! Our skill was interrupted by the dragon's counterattack!

TextContext.SourceString: 不过不要紧，我们还有机会的！伙伴，作为一个新人，你的技术已经很厉害啦！
TextContext.LocalizedString: No worries, we've still got this! For a newbie, your skills are impressive!

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，当心啊，毒龙开始喷吐毒雾了，赶快通过翻滚远离前面那片区域！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Look out, partner! The dragon’s spewing toxic gas—roll away from that area now!

TextContext.SourceString: 啊，你中毒了，我马上过来救你！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Oh no, you've been poisoned! I'm on my way!

TextContext.SourceString: 来不及了，我们都中毒身亡了……前面收集的装备和道具全部掉落了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's too late. We have both died from the poison... We've lost all the gear and items we collected...

TextContext.SourceString: 对不起啊，伙伴，我不该一遭遇毒龙，就莽着上去开大招……是我连累你了。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm sorry, partner. I shouldn't have started with my ultimate as soon as the battle started... I let you down...

TextContext.SourceString: （仿佛遭遇了巨大打击，失落沮丧的女孩低垂下了头。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (As if struck by a heavy blow, her head droops in disappointment and dejection.)

TextContext.SourceString: （但是在下一秒她蓝色的眸子里立马又燃起了斗志——）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (But in the very next moment, a fire of determination reignites in her blue eyes.)

TextContext.SourceString: 作为一名超级玩家，我是不会就这样轻易放弃的！
TextContext.LocalizedString: But as a super gamer, I'm not going to give up that easily!

TextContext.SourceString: （再次挑战第一关，我和米雪儿的配合变得更加默契。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Taking on the first level again, Michele and I are totally in sync with our strategies.)

TextContext.SourceString: （米雪儿瞄准了一处隐藏陷阱将毒龙引诱过去，我趁机配合她使出了两位主角的连携绝技——剑盾合一！）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (Michele lures the dragon into a hidden trap, and I seize the opportunity to unleash our ultimate combo move.)

TextContext.SourceString: （顷刻间，剑与盾之间发出一道耀眼的金光，吞天食地的毒龙被我们的武器撕裂成两半。）
TextContext.LocalizedString: (In an instant, a dazzling golden light bursts forth from the sword and shield, slicing the mighty dragon in half.)

TextContext.SourceString: 干得漂亮，伙伴，我们做到了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Nice work, partner, we nailed it!

TextContext.SourceString: 哎，好累好累，总算通关了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whew, that was intense. We finally cleared the level...

TextContext.SourceString: 哎嘿嘿，其实……这就是我米雪儿的“玩家思维”，选择最近的道路，找出最快的解法，并不是所有人都能理解……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hehe, you know... that's my gamer mindset in action: finding the shortest path and the quickest solution. Not everyone gets it...

TextContext.SourceString: 很有玩家风格的思维方式呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: It's a real gamer's way of thinking!

TextContext.SourceString: 来自同伴的肯定……我真的好感动……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Your approval means a lot to me...

TextContext.SourceString: 和我的思维方式一样呢！
TextContext.LocalizedString: We think alike!

TextContext.SourceString: 哎哎哎，难道说我遇到了同类了吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Haha! Have I finally found a like-minded friend?

TextContext.SourceString: 要是搜查科的执行长官们能像你一样通情达理就好了……这样我就能少写不少检讨书了……
TextContext.LocalizedString: If only the chief inspectors at the Investigation Bureau were as understanding as you... Maybe I’d have fewer self-reflection reports to write...

TextContext.SourceString: 咳咳，不提那些烦心事了！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Anyway, let's not dwell on that!

TextContext.SourceString: 伙伴，除了热血刺激的游戏，我还知道其他很多新奇有趣的东西喔。下次过来，我带你到其他地方转转吧？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hey, besides these thrilling games, I know tons of other cool and interesting stuff. I'll show you around next time you visit.

TextContext.SourceString: 呼啊~好困好困，上下眼皮就像被胶水黏住了一样……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ah, I'm so tired. I can fall asleep any second now...

TextContext.SourceString: 不行不行，我必须打起精神来……
TextContext.LocalizedString: No. I must get it together...

TextContext.SourceString: 欸？！伙伴，你是什么时候来的？难道你会瞬移吗？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Whoa! When did you get here, partner? Can you teleport or something?

TextContext.SourceString: 我一直都在这里啊。
TextContext.LocalizedString: I've been here the whole time.

TextContext.SourceString: 真、真的吗？我完全没注意到……
TextContext.LocalizedString: R-Really? I totally didn't notice you...

TextContext.SourceString: 没错，我会瞬移！
TextContext.LocalizedString: Yep, I can teleport!

TextContext.SourceString: 哈哈~很像是伙伴的发言呢，多亏你，我的瞌睡都醒了一半。
TextContext.LocalizedString: Ha ha~ That sounds just like something you'd say! Thanks to you, I'm halfway awake now.

TextContext.SourceString: 今天伙伴是来找我玩的吧？但是对不起啦，伙伴……
TextContext.LocalizedString: You're here to hang out with me, right? I'm sorry, partner...

TextContext.SourceString: 你看，我身旁的检讨堆得像山一样高，所以，今天可能……
TextContext.LocalizedString: See that mountain of reports next to me? So, today might be a bit...

TextContext.SourceString: 先等一等……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hang on...

TextContext.SourceString: 米雪儿，你是不是忘了什么？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Are you forgetting something, Michele?

TextContext.SourceString: 怎么了啦，伙伴？
TextContext.LocalizedString: What is it, partner?

TextContext.SourceString: 说起来，你从刚才起就神神秘秘的……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Now that I think about it, you've been acting all mysterious...

TextContext.SourceString: 看伙伴的表情，总觉得你接下来会作出某种惊人之举，或者要宣布什么重磅消息……
TextContext.LocalizedString: With that look on your face, I just know you're about to reveal something big...

TextContext.SourceString: 没时间了，快跟我来。
TextContext.LocalizedString: No time to explain. Come with me.

TextContext.SourceString: 接下来要邀请米雪儿参加一个神秘活动……
TextContext.LocalizedString: I'm taking you to a mysterious event...

TextContext.SourceString: 等一下，伙伴，先让我把纸和笔放下来……你、你要带我去做什么啊？
TextContext.LocalizedString: Hold on, partner, let me put down my pen and paper first... W-Where are you taking me?

TextContext.SourceString: 咳咳，暂时先闭上眼睛哦，米雪儿……
TextContext.LocalizedString: Close your eyes, Michele...
